data.name: Astounding Avoidance
data.description: The subject can avoid damage from magical and unusual attacks. The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject attempts a saving throw against an attack or spell that normally deals half damage on a successful save, before the subject rolls the save. If the subject succeeds at her save, she takes no damage.

raw_tokens.value: The subject can avoid damage from magical and unusual attacks. The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject attempts a saving throw against an attack or spell that normally deals half damage on a successful save, before the subject rolls the save. If the subject succeeds at her save, she takes no damage.
The subject takes only half damage is she fails her save. |PREVARGTEQ:MesmeristLVL,12
The benefits of this trick don't stack with those of the evasion or stalwart class features.
